Counsel for Petitioner :- Dhirendra Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A for the State respondents.

The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 15.10.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 198 of 2022 under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC at Police Station Gyanpur,
District Bhadohi.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner is totally innocent and has not committed any offence.
He submits that it is only after verification surety and bail bond were accepted in favour of the petitioner.

It is clear that sureties and bail bonds are not forged and were produced, separately for two Cases, which was converted into Section 391) of the Gangster Act as well and Case Crime No. 143 of 2022 under Sections 365, 394, 395, 412, 120B IPC, P.S. Aurai,
District Bhadohi, which were accepted by the court below.
Learned AGA opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.
He further submits that a large number of accused persons were released on the basis of forged sureties and bail bonds and the accused of heinous crimes were released on bail.
He submits that the petitioner is also working in an organised manner and is directly involved and cognizable offence is made out on bare reading of FIR.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
